items.name: HireKey
items.tagline: Your recruiter-informed AI copilot for tech job search
items.description: HireKey is a recruiter-informed AI job-search co-pilot for tech job seekers who want to apply strategically & interview with confidence. It helps you assess your role fit, tailor resumes, communicate experience & track applications. Unlike basic ATS tools, HireKey combines AI with 10 years of recruiting experience at Microsoft, Amazon & Stripe, plus practice out loud with an interactive AI voice coach that responds to your answers & provides real-time interview feedback.

items.name: kōdlo
items.tagline: End-to-end sales workspace with unified context
items.description: kōdlo finds prospects that fit your ICP and tells you how to warm each one up. Upload product catalogues and other docs to the Knowledge Hub, and its agent turns them into personalized messages, offers, deep searches and decks. Track client data, collaborate with your team, and manage tasks, all in one place. Connect Claude Desktop/ChatGPT Work or your code agent with kōdlo MCP to scale and orchestrate contexts.

items.name: Automations in Perplexity Computer
items.tagline: Automations that remember, act, and keep work moving
items.description: Computer Automations turns recurring work into reliable, ongoing workflows. Define a task once... such as monitoring sources, compiling reports, updating trackers, or drafting follow-ups... and an agent executes it on a schedule or in response to triggers. Built for professionals, teams, and operations leaders who need continuity without constant supervision, it remembers prior runs, builds on accumulated context, and acts proactively rather than waiting for a prompt.

items.name: Ghost Core
items.tagline: A personal AI computer that runs entirely on-device
items.description: Ghost Core is a personal AI computer that runs AI models on-device, connects to your apps, files, and devices, and builds continuous context to proactively help you.

items.name: OpenScreen 2
items.tagline: Record your demo and let your AI agent do the edits
items.description: Record your screen and the demo looks great on the first take: zooms planned from your clicks, smooth cursor, 3D camera moves, cursor themes, backgrounds and webcam layouts. Then let your AI agent do the edit over MCP, or cut the video yourself by deleting words in the transcript. Windows, macOS and Linux. Free, MIT, no account, no watermark.

items.name: FocusWrite
items.tagline: A local-first writing app with focus modes.
items.description: A calm, local-first writing app with deep focus, ambient sounds, optional cloud sync, and PDF export.

items.name: MePersona
items.tagline: Answer every fan comment in your voice
items.description: MePersona is the unified social media inbox for content creators, but the inbox is only where it starts. Your Persona learns how you talk and improves with every reply you approve. It drafts replies to comments and DMs from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and more, scores how much each sounds like you, and remembers what each fan said last time. Nothing posts until you hit Send. It works in English and Spanish, so bilingual creators stop choosing which half of their audience gets a real answer.

items.name: Foley
items.tagline: A voice to-do list that files, plans and asks first
items.description: Say what needs doing. Foley turns it into a task with the project, date and reminder already set, and asks when it isn't sure instead of guessing. When plans change, say so and it moves the task. Ask it to plan your day, or what to work on first, and it answers from your list. Capture from your Apple Watch. The desktop app is free with no account, using your own OpenRouter key. Foley Pro runs the AI for you and syncs every device. On iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and the web.

items.name: Gboard Kurukuru Version
items.tagline: Your fingers stay put. The keys come around
items.description: Gboard Kurukuru Version is a conveyor belt keyboard from Google Japan's Gboard team, its 15th. Four belts carry 29 keys each past your fingers, so one hand can reach every character. It isn't for sale, but STL files, firmware and a build guide are on GitHub.

items.name: Ayven
items.tagline: Carries and drives your team's agenda
items.description: Ayven drives your agenda. It means observing, cutting the work into pieces your team can take one at a time, putting an owner and a date on each, and filing them in Jira or YouTrack. Then it runs, tracks and talks about the work for weeks: asking whoever knows, waiting, chasing silence, moving work when someone is away. Your team answers in Slack and the board moves. Planning stops being the barrier and you ship your agenda like crazy.

items.name: Edgee Mod for Claude Code
items.tagline: Use any model inside Claude Code, keep your Claude plan
items.description: A Claude Code mod that puts Edgee in your terminal. Keep your Claude plan, switch your session to any of 200+ models in one keystroke, and see live what compression and routing save you. Same conversation, same context. Two commands to install.

items.name: Agibot
items.tagline: The always-on personal AI agent for your Mac. $0 forever
items.description: Agibot is an always-on personal AI agent that runs on your Mac. It keeps working in the background, even after you close the window. It can send you a morning brief, keep an eye on things and tell you when something changes, and handle tasks on the web for you. Chat with it in the app, on Telegram or on Slack. It remembers what you tell it, learns from your corrections and asks before doing anything risky. Free forever with your own API key.

items.name: SimpleSpread
items.tagline: Native, open source Mac spreadsheet
items.description: Ever double click a CSV or XLSX file on your mac and have to wait 30 seconds while Numbers loads? And when it loads it's filled with a ton of crap you don't need? Then I wrote this for you (well mostly me, but you might find it cool too). A small, fast spreadsheet for the Mac, written entirely in Swift. Free and MIT open source with XLSX as the native file format. 156 functions, incremental recalc, Excel-style keyboard editing.

items.name: Tori
items.tagline: Japanese listening practice built from your own sentences
items.description: One app packed with multiple ways to listen to what you use the most. Paste what you read or journal about your day, and Tori translates each sentence, adds furigana and audio, and files it into topic islands. Then hear it four ways: passive listening with the screen off, shadowing that plays your voice next to the model, AI stories at your level, and SRS flashcards with audio on every card. When you're ready, practice speaking with an AI tutor in 15 real scenarios.

items.name: Kooler
items.tagline: Find cocktails you can make with what's in your bar
items.description: Kooler is a free cocktail recipe app for people who like making drinks at home. - My Bar: add the bottles and ingredients you have and see every drink you can make right now - 100+ curated recipes: classics, modern cocktails and Brazilian drinks like Caipirinha, Rabo de Galo and Macunaíma - Clear measurements, step-by-step methods and consistent photos - Check-ins: rate a drink you had at a bar and share it No ads, no paywall. Web + iOS.

items.name: DevTerminal
items.tagline: A macOS terminal with a Run button that knows your project
items.description: DevTerminal is a normal macOS terminal (your shell, your config) where every tab knows what project it's in. ⌘R in an Android app installs it on your phone and streams logcat. In an iOS app it launches in the Simulator or on your iPhone. Spring Boot, Next.js, Flutter, React Native, Rust, Go, Django, Rails and more just work. Run output sits under your shell, so Claude Code keeps the tab. $39 once, no subscription.

items.name: shippedit.me
items.tagline: Launch Platform with SEO, AEO & Growth Insights
items.description: Weekly launch battles + a permanent page that keeps working: dofollow backlink, AEO & CRO audits, competitor monitoring, real analytics, and AI fix cards.

items.name: FloorGen
items.tagline: Draw the house, or just ask. Free floor plans with AI
items.description: Plan a remodel, an ADU or a whole house for free in your browser. Describe it and FloorGen AI builds it, every change an undo step. Then check it against the IRC, walk through it in 3D and print the plan set. Claude and ChatGPT can edit it too.

items.name: Unboom
items.tagline: Tames boomy room bass on your Mac without acoustic panels
items.description: Unboom finds the bass note your untreated room exaggerates and gently turns just that down on your Mac. Scan with your mic or pick it by ear, choose Gentle, Medium, or Strong, and flip Correction on. Never boosts. No data collected. No subscription.

items.name: NewMinecraftServers
items.tagline: Minecraft server discovery, analytics, & spoof detection.
items.description: NewMinecraftServers helps players find their next Minecraft community and gives server owners tools to grow theirs. Discover Java and Bedrock servers, explore player statistics, and follow activity trends before choosing where to play. Owners can claim and promote their server listing, showcase their community, and access detailed analytics on player counts, uptime, peak activity, and busiest hours -- making it easier to understand their audience and attract new players.
